result.title: NVIDIA Bionemo Inference Runtime
result.description:
NVIDIA BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR) 

Accelerates biomolecular structure prediction inference for models like OpenFold3 and Boltz-2 on NVIDIA H100 and H200 GPUs.

By optimizing discovery-scale workloads, BioIR reduces the energy required to generate 31 million protein complex predictions for the AlphaFold Database by an estimated 1.35 GWh - the equivalent of 18,000 EV charges or 5.4 million electric vehicle miles.

GitHub - https://nvda.ws/3UKXFy4
Tech blog - https://nvda.ws/4dchK6H

result.title: Editing Faster in Adobe Premiere with NVIDIA RTX Spark
result.description:
RTX Spark is built to accelerate demanding creative workflows, helping editors spend less time waiting and more time creating.

This demo shows how NVIDIA RTX-acceleration in Adobe Premiere can speed up scene edit detection, enable real-time color correction, track objects with one click and play back multiple streams of 4K 10-bit footage without transcoding or low-resolution proxies.

result.title: Building Europe's AI Stack — Inside the Barcelona Supercomputing Center
result.description:
We sat down with the Barcelona Supercomputing Center to talk about what it really takes to turn a continent's scientific ambition into an AI powerhouse.

BSC hosts MareNostrum 5 — one of the largest supercomputers in Europe. But raw compute is just the start. The BSC AI Factory, backed by the European Commission, is doing something harder: compressing the journey from idea to deployable AI product for the startups and SMEs who can't afford to wait.

The model is simple in concept, hard to execute: energy → chips → infrastructure → models → applications. Five layers. One coherent stack.
